scientific_integrity: The sign and exact coefficient counts have an algebraic proof. Finite-field enumeration is corroboration only; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic, fixed admissible exponent, and coefficientwise parity only. No assertion for even characteristic or parity after identifying functions across different exponents. Two directly relevant 2026 classification papers were accessible as abstracts, not complete text, leaving a material originality risk.
title: A universal sign bias for classified finite-field permutation binomials
